native_skill_api.source: one async function run(api, args), returning {success:boolean,message:string,data?:object}
native_skill_api.target: !skill_<name>; this is a NEW command, not one of the existing primitives

methods.now(): async -> timestamp in ms; use this for deadlines so simulation time works
methods.wait(ms): async, 0..2000 per call; check conditions in bounded loops
methods.skill(name,argsArray): async invoke ANY exported native library skill; examples collectBlock:[blockName,count], discard:[itemName,count], goToPosition:[x,y,z,minDistance], equip:[itemName], smeltItem:[rawItemName,count], placeBlock:[name,x,y,z]
methods.command(text): async execute a Minecraft slash command with existing server permissions
methods.openFurnace(position): async -> handle number; close it before opening another
methods.furnace(handle,op,...args): async; op=state|putInput(item,count)|putFuel(item,count)|takeOutput|close. Load different furnaces sequentially; their burning proceeds in parallel in the world

postconditions.surface: {type:'surface'}; must actually go from submerged to air
postconditions.state_report: {type:'state_report',fields:['health','oxygen','inventory',...]} -> return data matching actual host state, additional computed fields allowed
postconditions.blocks_present: {type:'blocks_present',block:string|{arg:index},positions:JSON-string|{arg:index}}; positions encodes [[x,y,z],...] and at least one block must change

native_skill_api.tests: 2..6 cases {name,args:[],state:{inventory,position,health,food,oxygen,empty_slots,submerged,blocks:[{name,position}]},expect_success:boolean,expected_data?:{computedField:value}}. Success is independently checked against the postcondition. Test fixtures support state/blocks/control, equip, collectBlock, discard, goToPosition, placeBlock, smeltItem and furnace operations
